title: Rust: REST API (Simulated)
description: Build a simulated REST API with CRUD endpoints for a resource.

steps.title: Define Resource and Store
steps.description: Define a `Task` struct with `id: u32, title: String, completed: bool`. Create a `TaskStore` that manages tasks in a `HashMap<u32, Task>`. Add methods `list()`, `get(id)`, `create(task)`, `update(id, task)`, `delete(id)`.
hints: `struct Task { id: u32, title: String, completed: bool }`

verification.failureMessage: Create a TaskStore and demonstrate CRUD.

steps.title: Router with RESTful Routes
steps.description: Create a `Router` with RESTful routes for tasks: `GET /tasks` (list), `GET /tasks/:id` (get), `POST /tasks` (create), `PUT /tasks/:id` (update), `DELETE /tasks/:id` (delete).
hints: Map HTTP method + path pattern to handler functions.
`POST /tasks` handler creates a task from query params.
`DELETE /tasks/:id` removes and returns the deleted task.

verification.failureMessage: Register all 5 REST endpoints and print their configurations.

steps.title: Simulate Requests
steps.description: Simulate a sequence: POST to create 2 tasks, GET /tasks to list all, GET /tasks/1 to get first, PUT /tasks/1 to mark complete, DELETE /tasks/2, then GET /tasks to show final state.
hints: Call your route handlers directly with Request objects.
Print the response body after each operation.
Verify the task list after all operations.

verification.failureMessage: Run the full CRUD sequence and print all responses.

steps.title: Error Handling
steps.description: Handle errors: return 404 if task not found, 400 if invalid data. Create an `ApiResult<T>` type alias for `Result<T, (u16, String)>` (status code + error message). Test with invalid requests.

verification.failureMessage: Test with a non-existent task ID and get 404.

steps.title: Pagination Support
steps.description: Add pagination to the list endpoint: `GET /tasks?page=1&limit=2`. Return only the requested slice, plus total count. Create 5 tasks and test with page 1 (limit 2) and page 2.
hints: Parse `page` and `limit` from query params (default page=1, limit=10).
`let start = (page - 1) * limit; let end = start + limit;`

verification.failureMessage: List tasks with pagination and print both page 1 and page 2.
